# =============================================================================
# tessera-term: OSC 8 hyperlinks   (issue #30 part 2 of 3, wave 8)
# crates/tessera-term/tests/fixtures/hyperlink_spec.txt
# spec-researcher output (2026-10-31). STATUS: COMPLETE for 0.1.0 scope (see DECISIONS at the end).
# ONLY THE MILESTONE LEAD EDITS A FINALISED COPY; the implementer copies it verbatim.
#
# Layout: `###` rows as osc_spec.txt (size / step / cite / note / screen / cursor / pending_wrap / requests /
# scrollback) plus the keys below. tests/hyperlink.rs needs its own parser (see osc_spec.txt header).
#   links:   per-cell link assertions: `(r,c)=uri[#id]` list; cells not listed must carry NO link.
#            `uri` is the exact stored URI, `#id` the explicit id when present (stored separately from the URI).
#            `none` = no cell carries a link.
#   active:  the grid's active link after the last step: none | uri[#id]
#   same:    groups of cells that must intern to ONE link entity: `same: (0,0)(0,2)`; `distinct: (0,0)(0,1)` the opposite
#   links_scrollback: `s0:(0-1)=uri` oldest history line s0, columns, for rows that push lines into history
#   rejected: true when the OSC must be ignored entirely (active link unchanged, nothing stored)
#   links entries are `(row,col)` or `(row,c0-c1)` ranges, `=uri`, optional `#id`.
# PAYLOAD ESCAPES and @rep(C,N): exactly as osc_spec.txt (\xNN \r \n \\ \u{H..}; @rep(a,2070) = 2070 'a'). Every row runs
#   whole, byte-at-a-time and every 2-way split (osc_spec.txt chunking rule) and must give the same result.
# Shorthand in `step:`: ESC ST is written \x1b\\ ; OSC 8 open = \x1b]8;<params>;<uri>\x1b\\ ; close = \x1b]8;;\x1b\\
#
# SOURCE TAGS (fetched 2026-10-31; read not run)
#   GIST  https://gist.github.com/egmontkob/eb114294efbcd5adb1944c9f3cb5feda  "Hyperlinks (a.k.a. HTML-like anchors) in terminal emulators"
#   VTE   https://github.com/GNOME/vte  src/vteseq.cc Terminal::set_current_hyperlink L1746-1822; src/vtedefines.hh L101
#         VTE_HYPERLINK_URI_LENGTH_MAX 2083, L119 VTE_HYPERLINK_ID_LENGTH_MAX 250, L110 COUNT_MAX (1<<20)-2
#   KT    https://github.com/kovidgoyal/kitty  kitty/screen.c set_active_hyperlink L1067 (empty URL closes), do_screen_reset L246
#         (active link cleared on hard AND soft reset), screen_toggle_screen_buffer L1970 (cleared on a screen switch);
#         kitty/hyperlink.c MAX_KEY_LEN 2048, MAX_ID_LEN 256 (key "id:url" is truncated), pool capped (HYPERLINK_MAX_NUMBER)
#   WZ    https://github.com/wezterm/wezterm  wezterm-escape-parser/src/hyperlink.rs Hyperlink::parse (URI = osc[2..].join(';'),
#         non-UTF-8 rejected, params without `=` are an error => whole OSC dropped, all params kept)
#   GH    https://github.com/ghostty-org/ghostty  src/terminal/osc/parsers/hyperlink.zig (no `;` => invalid; unknown option
#         logged and skipped; empty id ignored; empty URI + id => invalid; empty URI => hyperlink_end)
#   OSC   crates/tessera-term/tests/fixtures/osc_spec.txt header item 3 (C0 bytes inside an OSC are dropped by the parser layer)
#   ADR8  docs/adr/0008 (grapheme side table: the pattern the link table mirrors); 30-links brief D-STORE
# =============================================================================

### L10_empty_uri_with_params_closes
size: 2x20
step: feed \x1b]8;;https://a.bc/\x1b\\a\x1b]8;id=x;\x1b\\b
cite: [VTE] L1805: `len > 0 && len <= MAX` else idx 0 (closes); [KT] set_active_hyperlink: `!url[0]` => 0
links: (0,0)=https://a.bc/

note: DISAGREEMENT: Ghostty treats "empty URI + id" as invalid (ignored, the old link stays open), WezTerm builds a link with an empty URI. Recommend VTE/kitty: an empty URI ALWAYS closes. Lead decision D-L2.

### L12_uri_at_length_cap_accepted
size: 2x20
step: feed \x1b]8;;https://a.bc/@rep(a,2070)\x1b\\x\x1b]8;;\x1b\\
cite: [GIST] "Both VTE and iTerm2 limit the URI to 2083 bytes"; [VTE] VTE_HYPERLINK_URI_LENGTH_MAX 2083, accepts `len <= MAX`
links: (0,0)=https://a.bc/@rep(a,2070)
active: none
note: `https://a.bc/` is 13 bytes + 2070 = 2083, the longest accepted URI.

### L13_uri_over_cap_closes_the_link
size: 2x20
step: feed \x1b]8;;https://a.bc/A\x1b\\a\x1b]8;;https://a.bc/@rep(a,2071)\x1b\\b
cite: [VTE] L1815-1822: an overlong URI is "ignoring" AND `idx = get_hyperlink_idx(nullptr)`: the active link is cleared
links: (0,0)=https://a.bc/A
active: none
note: 13 + 2071 = 2084 bytes. `b` has NO link (neither A nor the overlong one). AMBIGUITY: "ignore and keep A" is the other defensible choice; VTE clears, so an attacker cannot make text look as if it belongs to the previous link. Recommend VTE. Lead decision D-L3. The cap counts URI bytes only.

### L14_id_at_and_over_cap
size: 2x20
step: feed \x1b]8;id=@rep(i,250);https://a.bc/\x1b\\a\x1b]8;;\x1b\\\x1b]8;id=@rep(i,251);https://a.bc/\x1b\\b\x1b]8;;\x1b\\
cite: [GIST] "VTE limits id to 250 bytes"; [VTE] L1774: `len > 3 + VTE_HYPERLINK_ID_LENGTH_MAX` => "Overlong id ignored", the URI still applies with an auto id
links: (0,0)=https://a.bc/#@rep(i,250) (0,1)=https://a.bc/
active: none
note: `a` keeps its 250-byte id; `b` gets the link WITHOUT an id (its id is dropped, not the link). kitty truncates the id to 256 instead; Tessera follows VTE.

### L15_invalid_utf8_in_uri_rejected
size: 2x20
step: feed \x1b]8;;https://a.bc/\xff\x1b\\x
cite: [WZ] String::from_utf8(uri)? fails => OSC dropped; [GIST] non-ASCII bytes are to be percent-encoded, so a raw invalid byte is malformed
links: none
rejected: true
active: none
note: Valid UTF-8 above 0x7F (L16) is accepted although the gist asks for percent-encoding.

### L16_valid_utf8_in_uri_accepted_as_is
size: 2x20
step: feed \x1b]8;;https://a.bc/\u{e9}\x1b\\x\x1b]8;;\x1b\\
cite: [GIST] "must not contain any bytes outside 32-126 ... percent-encoded" is a portability rule for senders; [WZ]/[GH] store the string as received
links: (0,0)=https://a.bc/\u{e9}
active: none
note: Stored raw (D-SEC); the Swift side percent-encodes when it builds a URL to open.

### L17_c0_byte_inside_uri_is_dropped_by_the_osc_layer
size: 2x20
step: feed \x1b]8;;https://a.b\x01c/\x1b\\x\x1b]8;;\x1b\\
cite: osc_spec.txt header item 3 (vte silently drops C0 bytes 0x00-0x06, 0x08-0x17, ... inside an OSC); the 30-links brief row "control bytes rejected" is therefore already true one layer down
links: (0,0)=https://a.bc/
active: none
note: BRIEF CORRECTION: nothing for hyperlink.rs to do beyond the existing OSC string rules.

### L33_no_id_two_runs_same_uri_are_distinct_even_when_adjacent
size: 2x20

cite: [VTE] a fresh auto id (":N") per OSC 8 open without an id; [GIST] "Cells without an id are grouped by heuristics that differ between terminals. VTE groups cells from a single OSC 8 run. iTerm2 groups adjacent cells with the same URI."

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DECISIONS (also in selection_spec.notes.md)
#   D-L1 params without `=`: ignore the param, keep the link (VTE, Ghostty) [WezTerm drops the OSC]
#   D-L2 empty URI always closes, whatever params it carries (VTE, kitty) [Ghostty ignores, WezTerm stores an empty URI]
#   D-L3 URI > 2083 bytes closes the active link (VTE); id > 250 bytes is dropped, link kept (VTE)
#   D-L4 no-id links: identity = one OSC 8 open (VTE) [iTerm2: adjacent same-URI cells group]
#   D-L5 DECSTR and screen switches clear the ACTIVE link (kitty verified, VTE screen switch verified)
#   Not covered by a row (unit tests instead): table cap (recommend 65,536 live links; kitty and VTE cap their pools:
#   VTE_HYPERLINK_COUNT_MAX (1<<20)-2, kitty HYPERLINK_MAX_NUMBER), memory bound under a 1,000,000 rewrite flood.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
